product.name: shellspec
product.eyebrow: Shell command records · no release yet
product.lede: A coding agent's shell tool sends a whole script in one string: cd app && cargo test 2>&1 | tail. shellspec lifts that string from bash, sh, zsh or fish into one tree, lists every simple command in the order the shell runs it, and gives each a category such as navigate, test or filter. Nothing is executed, expanded or globbed.
product.description: A Rust library and CLI that lifts shell command strings from bash, sh, zsh and fish into one tree and classifies every simple command with a ruleset you can extend.

sections.title: From a string to a classified list.
sections.lede: Each step is a function of the library and a command of the shellspec tool.

steps.label: lift
steps.title: Parse in a dialect
steps.description: lift returns the tree of one command string. Input that does not parse becomes unk nodes with a reason, never an error.

steps.label: invocations
steps.title: List and classify
steps.description: invocations lists every simple command with its wrappers, pipe stage, guard, working directory and category.

steps.label: shape
steps.title: Redact
steps.description: shape keeps programs, subcommands and flags, and replaces every value with a placeholder.

items.title: Dialects

items.description: The tree, the words, the invocation list and the dominant invocation.
